title: Judgment on Ammon, Edom, Damascus, Kedar, Hazor, and Elam

questions.question: Concerning the Ammonites. The Lord asks, "Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then has... taken possession of Gad, and his people settled in its cities?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:1 (ESV): "Why then has Milcom taken possession of Gad, and his people settled in its cities?" (Milcom was the national god of the Ammonites).

questions.question: What city of the Ammonites will become a desolate mound, and her villages burned with fire?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:2 (ESV): "when I will cause the battle cry to be heard against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it shall become a desolate mound, and its villages shall be burned with fire;"

questions.question: "Then... shall dispossess those who dispossessed him, says the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:2 (ESV): "then Israel shall dispossess those who dispossessed him, says the Lord."

questions.question: Concerning Edom, the Lord asks, "Is... no longer in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:7 (ESV): "Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?"

questions.question: The Lord will bring the disaster of... upon Edom.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:8 (ESV): "for I will bring the disaster of Esau upon him, the time when I punish him."

questions.question: "For I have sworn by myself, declares the Lord, that... shall become a horror, a taunt, a waste, and a curse, and all her cities shall be perpetual wastes."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:13 (ESV): "that Bozrah shall become a horror, a taunt, a waste, and a curse, and all her cities shall be perpetual wastes."

questions.question: Against Edom: "Though you soar as high as the... , and though your nest is set among the stars, from there I will bring you down, declares the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:16 (ESV): "Though you soar as high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, from there I will bring you down, declares the Lord."

questions.question: "Edom shall become a horror. Everyone who passes by it will be horrified and will... because of all its disasters."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:17 (ESV): "Everyone who passes by it will be horrified and will hiss because of all its disasters."

questions.question: "As when... and... and their neighboring cities were overthrown, says the Lord, no man shall dwell there, no man shall sojourn in her."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:18 (ESV): "As when Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighboring cities were overthrown, says the Lord,"

questions.question: Concerning Damascus: "Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard bad news; they... in anxiety, like the sea that cannot be quiet."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:23 (ESV): "they melt in anxiety, like the sea that cannot be quiet."

questions.question: "Damascus has become feeble, she turned to flee, and... seized her; anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in labor."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:24 (ESV): "Damascus has become feeble, she turned to flee, and panic seized her;"

questions.question: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor that Nebuchadnezzar struck down: "Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the people of the... !"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:28 (ESV): "Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the people of the east!"

questions.question: The people of Kedar are described as dwelling in what kind of structure?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:29 (ESV): "Their tents and their flocks shall be taken, their tent curtains and all their goods;"

questions.question: In the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah, Jeremiah prophesied concerning Elam: "Behold, I will break the... of Elam, the mainstay of their might."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:35 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord of hosts: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might."

questions.question: "But in the latter days I will restore the fortunes of... , declares the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 49:39 (ESV): "But in the latter days I will restore the fortunes of Elam, declares the Lord."

key_verse_text: "The horror you inspire has deceived you, and the pride of your heart, you who live in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill. Though you make your nest as high as the eagle's, I will bring you down from there, declares the Lord."
